int main() {
    int P, K;
    cin >> P >> K;
    vector<int> Parent(P + 1), Rank(P + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= P; ++i) {
        Parent[i] = i;
    }
    function<int(int)> find_parent = [&](int nd) {
        if (Parent[nd] != nd) {
            Parent[nd] = find_parent(Parent[nd]);
        }
        return Parent[nd];
    };
    auto Union = [&](int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]) {
            Parent[nd2] = nd1;
            ++Rank[nd1];
        } else {
            Parent[nd1] = nd2;
            ++Rank[nd2];
        }
    };
    for (int i = 1; i <= P; ++i) {
        int value = (long long)K * i % P;
        int Pa = find_parent(i);
        int Pb = find_parent(value);
        if (Pa != Pb) {
            Union(Pa, Pb);
        }
    }
    set<int> groups;
    for (int i = 1; i <= P; ++i) {
        groups.insert(find_parent(i));
    }
    long long ways;
    const long long MAXN = 1000000007;
    function<long long(long long, long long, long long)> fast_exp_pow = [&](long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
        long long res = 1;
        while (exp) {
            if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };
    if (K == 0) {
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P - 1, MAXN);
    } else if (K == 1) {
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P, MAXN);
    } else {
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, (long long)groups.size(), MAXN);
    }
    cout << ways << "\n";
    return 0;
}
